prompt: Complete the static methods in Schedule: isWeekend(Day d) returns true only for SAT and SUN, and next(Day d) returns the following day, wrapping SUN back around to MON.
explanation: Enum constants are unique objects, so they can be compared safely with ==. Every enum also gets a static values() method returning all constants in declaration order, and each constant knows its position via ordinal(). Adding 1 to the ordinal and taking the remainder with the array length is the classic way to step to the next constant with wrap-around.
hints: For isWeekend, compare with ==: d == Day.SAT || d == Day.SUN.
Day.values() returns the array {MON, TUE, ..., SUN} and d.ordinal() is d's index in that array.
To wrap SUN (ordinal 6) back to MON (ordinal 0), use (d.ordinal() + 1) % Day.values().length as the index.
